newsitem.title: FRANCE: Morgan Stanley raises rating on L'Oreal.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley raises rating on L'Oreal.

text.p: U.S. investment firm Morgan Stanley raised its rating on the stock of L'Oreal to outperform from neutral after concluding that it was undervalued.

"The share is trading in line with its U.S. rivals and LVMH, on the basis of valuation to earnings before depreciation, interest and tax, when L'Oreal offers superior long-term growth potential and much better visibility," said Morgan analyst Claire Windle.
She set a 2,100 franc objective for the stock, which was up 1.15 percent at 1,936 francs at 1400 GMT.
She said L'Oreal is well positioned with products in the luxury and mass markets.
